visual_identity.core_identity: A wormlike subterranean ambush predator with a thick segmented body and four fleshy tentacles opening around a hard central beak.
visual_identity.silhouette: Thick serpentine body rising from rubble, front end opening into four evenly spaced tentacles around the mouth.
visual_identity.head_features: No normal head; four muscular facial tentacles frame a small hard beak at the exact center.
visual_identity.body_shape: Long heavy worm body with subtle segmented folds and no legs.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No legs or arms; exactly four facial tentacles surround the central beak.
visual_identity.surface: Rubbery ringed skin with restrained segment lines.

known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly four facial tentacles around central beak

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium heavy worm whose body can rise from rubble or coil along a cave floor without filling the whole chamber.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Body rests on and coils against floor, rubble, or rock while the four facial tentacles open forward.
behavior_style: raising its beaked face from debris
environment_fit: deep caves and rocky underground passages
